stage_entry.text: 按术前标记进入盆腔，先确认切口范围。
stage_entry.text_en: Enter the pelvis along the preoperative markings. Confirm the incision extent first.

stage_entry.text: 暴露与初步止血器械已准备完毕。
stage_entry.text_en: The exposure and initial haemostasis instruments are ready.

stage_entry.text: 肠袢已经轻轻移开，盆壁的层次可以逐步显露。
stage_entry.text_en: The bowel loops have been gently displaced. We can expose the pelvic sidewall in stages.

stage_entry.text: 深部视野还受限，先调整牵开方向。
stage_entry.text_en: The deep view is still limited. Adjust the direction of retraction first.

stage_entry.text: 粘连牵涉盆壁多个层次，先找连续的安全分离面。
stage_entry.text_en: The adhesions cross several pelvic sidewall planes. Identify a consistent dissection plane first.

stage_entry.text: 这里的组织边界不够清楚，牵拉先放轻。
stage_entry.text_en: The tissue boundary is indistinct here. Reduce traction for now.

stage_entry.text: 精细分离所需的器械已经递上。
stage_entry.text_en: The instruments for delicate dissection are ready.

precision_failed.text: 这处粘连的分离层次偏离了计划，需要重新辨认。
precision_failed.text_en: The dissection has strayed from the intended adhesion plane. Reidentify it.

precision_failed.text: 先停一下，当前的组织界面还不能继续推进。
precision_failed.text_en: Pause. We cannot advance safely through this tissue interface yet.

stage_entry.text: 先确认输尿管及盆壁神经的相对位置。
stage_entry.text_en: Identify the relative positions of the ureter and pelvic nerves first.

stage_entry.text: 要保留的结构与切除边界非常接近。
stage_entry.text_en: The structures to preserve lie very close to the resection boundary.

stage_entry.text: 调整暴露，让深部走行始终在视野内。
stage_entry.text_en: Adjust exposure so the deeper anatomical course remains visible.

precision_failed.text: 重要结构的边界没有辨认充分，必须重新确认。
precision_failed.text_en: The boundaries of critical structures were not identified clearly enough. Reassess them.

precision_failed.text: 这一处不能凭估计分离，先纠正组织定位。
precision_failed.text_en: We cannot dissect this area by estimation. Correct the anatomical orientation first.

stage_entry.text: 进入血管处理阶段，先复核髂血管与病灶的关系。
stage_entry.text_en: Before handling the vessels, reassess their relationship to the lesion.

stage_entry.text: 当前暴露范围和术前影像要对应起来。
stage_entry.text_en: We need to match the current exposure to the preoperative imaging.

stage_entry.text: 髂血管壁就在分离面旁边，牵拉幅度要受控。
stage_entry.text_en: The iliac vessel wall is adjacent to the dissection plane. Control the traction.

stage_entry.text: 逐步辨认血管分支，再处理周围组织。
stage_entry.text_en: Identify the vascular branches progressively before working through the surrounding tissue.

stage_entry.text: 血管缝合和临时控制器械保持待命。
stage_entry.text_en: Vascular sutures and temporary control instruments are on standby.

precision_failed.text: 血管周围的分离还不够稳妥，需要修正。
precision_failed.text_en: The perivascular dissection is not secure enough. It needs correction.

precision_failed.text: 先恢复清楚的血管边界，再继续下一段。
precision_failed.text_en: Reestablish a clear vessel boundary before moving to the next section.

stage_entry.text: 现在处理肿瘤深部边界，注意与正常组织的交界。
stage_entry.text_en: We are working along the deep tumour margin. Watch the interface with normal tissue.

stage_entry.text: 深部空间狭窄，先稳住暴露再分离。
stage_entry.text_en: The deep space is narrow. Stabilize exposure before dissecting.

stage_entry.text: 确认切除平面与保留结构之间的距离。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm the distance between the resection plane and preserved structures.

precision_failed.text: 深部切除平面不符合预定边界，需要调整。
precision_failed.text_en: The deep resection plane does not match the intended boundary. Adjust it.

precision_failed.text: 这里的组织分离还不够完整，暂时不能继续。
precision_failed.text_en: The tissue separation is incomplete here. We should not proceed yet.

stage_entry.text: 准备移除标本，并重新评估盆壁术野。
stage_entry.text_en: Prepare to remove the specimen and reassess the pelvic sidewall field.

stage_entry.text: 切除区需要重新整理，接下来还要进行血管重建。
stage_entry.text_en: The resection area needs reorganizing before vascular reconstruction.

stage_entry.text: 标本容器及重建所需器械已就位。
stage_entry.text_en: The specimen container and reconstruction instruments are ready.

stage_entry.text: 进入髂血管重建，先核对两端的走行与长度。
stage_entry.text_en: We are beginning iliac vessel reconstruction. Check the orientation and length of both ends.

stage_entry.text: 保持血管端口稳定，避免重建时产生扭曲。
stage_entry.text_en: Keep the vessel ends stable to avoid twisting during reconstruction.

stage_entry.text: 血管吻合用缝线已准备好。
stage_entry.text_en: The sutures for the vascular anastomosis are ready.

precision_failed.text: 重建接口的对位不够理想，需要重新调整。
precision_failed.text_en: The reconstructed vessel ends are not aligned satisfactorily. Readjust them.

precision_failed.text: 先别恢复流程，血管重建这一处还需修正。
precision_failed.text_en: Do not resume the sequence. This part of the vascular reconstruction needs correction.

stage_entry.text: 再次确认盆壁神经走行与固定点关系。
stage_entry.text_en: Recheck the course of the pelvic nerves and their relationship to the fixation points.

stage_entry.text: 重建完成后还要排除局部牵拉对邻近结构的影响。
stage_entry.text_en: After reconstruction, we still need to check for traction on adjacent structures.

precision_failed.text: 这里的定位关系还没核对充分，需要再看一次。
precision_failed.text_en: The anatomical relationships have not been verified sufficiently. Review them again.

precision_failed.text: 固定点附近仍有不确定的组织边界，先修正。
precision_failed.text_en: The tissue boundary near the fixation point is still uncertain. Correct it first.

stage_entry.text: 检查重建血管的灌注，再完成最终止血评估。
stage_entry.text_en: Check perfusion through the reconstructed vessel, then complete the final haemostasis review.

stage_entry.text: 循环数据持续监测中，准备配合最后的灌注评估。
stage_entry.text_en: Haemodynamic monitoring continues. We are ready to assist with the final perfusion assessment.

stage_entry.text: 不要遗漏盆壁深处和重建接口附近的渗血点。
stage_entry.text_en: Do not overlook oozing deep in the pelvic sidewall or near the reconstruction.

stage_entry.text: 器械与纱布清点记录准备复核。
stage_entry.text_en: The instrument and swab count is ready for review.

stage_entry.text: 关闭前再次确认清点与手术记录。
stage_entry.text_en: Recheck the counts and operative record before closure.
